name: responses-max-output-tokens-unsupported
note: Upstream b8b873b98 (Go f57c288): compat.supportsMaxOutputTokens gates max_output_tokens on openai-responses. With the flag false and options.maxTokens set, the key must be ABSENT from the request body — Codex-protocol gateways 400 on it. Requires PI_UPSTREAM_SHA >= b8b873b98 (the flag does not exist at earlier shas, where max_output_tokens would still be emitted -> false FAIL). backend:"src" because pi-ai 0.84.4 predates b8b873b98 and cannot contain the flag; flip to "dist" once a release ships it (README rule). The default (true) arm is already covered by every other dist-backed openai-responses scenario, which all set maxTokens and emit max_output_tokens.
